main.description: Searches indexed activities by a case-insensitive literal substring in title or shortDescription. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; blank search imposes no text restriction. Other filters combine with search using AND and retain their listing semantics. Repeated unbracketed array values accept at most 100 supplied entries; duplicates are removed. Defaults are limit=25 and sortDirection=desc; limit is 1..100. Results sort by (createdAt, uri) and use a direction-bound opaque cursor. Authentication is not required.

search.description: Complete text substring to find in title or shortDescription; literal %, _, and other characters are not wildcards.

authors.description: Repository-owner DIDs to include; values use OR.

authorType.description: Organization authors have an organization sidecar; person authors have a profile and no organization sidecar.

contributors.description: Contributor DIDs to match against inline identities and exact referenced contributor-information versions; values use OR.

involvedActors.description: DIDs matching either the activity repository owner or a contributor; values use OR, then combine with other filters using AND.

uris.description: Activity AT-URIs for bounded batch hydration; input order is not preserved.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri); default desc.

limit.description: Maximum activities in this page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
errors.description: The activity query or required hydration lookup failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when pagination is complete.
